experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Begin your morning with a guided outdoor yoga session along the scenic Campuhan Ridge Walk in Ubud, surrounded by lush jungle and rice paddies. The cool morning air and serene landscape make this an ideal mindful movement experience. On rainy days, many local studios like Yoga Barn offer indoor classes as an alternative.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset Session
experiences.description: Spend the late afternoon at Seminyak Beach, one of Bali's most beautiful stretches of golden sand. Enjoy a beach yoga flow at dusk, watch the legendary Bali sunset, and unwind at a beachfront café. Avoid midday heat by arriving after 4:30 PM. Indoor alternative: visit a nearby spa or art gallery during the afternoon.

experiences.name: Balinese Cooking Class
experiences.description: Join a hands-on morning cooking class in Ubud where you'll visit a local market, learn about traditional Balinese spices, and cook authentic dishes like Nasi Goreng, Satay Lilit, and Lawar. This is a perfect indoor activity to escape midday heat while deeply engaging with Balinese food culture.

experiences.name: Tirta Empul Temple Purification Ritual
experiences.description: Experience a sacred Balinese Hindu purification ceremony at Tirta Empul, a holy water temple dating back to 962 AD. Participate respectfully in the melukat ritual by bathing in the spring-fed pools believed to have healing properties. Visit early morning to avoid crowds and heat. On overcast days, the experience is equally magical.

experiences.name: Stand-Up Paddleboarding at Sanur Beach
experiences.description: Enjoy a calm and beginner-friendly stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) session on the tranquil waters of Sanur Beach. The reef-protected lagoon offers flat, gentle waves ideal for all skill levels. Morning sessions are best before the wind picks up. If weather turns, explore Sanur's charming beachside promenade or local warungs for fresh seafood.
